dct_description_sm: The objective of the Marine Basic Zackenberg program is to contribute to ecosystem research in the High Arctic by conducting (1) basic quantitative documentation of ecosystem structure and processes; (2) baseline studies of intrinsic short-term and long-term variations in ecosystem functions; (3) retrospective analyses of organic and inorganic material to detect past ecosystem changes and (4) experimental studies enabling predictions of ecosystem responses to Global Changes. This study aims at testing the two hypothesis: (1) that climate change is changing benthic macro mega-faunal communities in the Atlantic Arctic Gateway (AAG), with subsequent cascade effects in ecosystem function; (2) that alien species can change benthic communities with subsequent cascade effects in ecosystem function.
dct_title_s: Physico-chemical parameters, biomass and species composition of benthic communities in northeast Greenland
